Test or junk submission (placeholder name, company and message).

Lead used a disposable email, provided no website, and explicitly requested complete methodology and past client results (pricing/methodology research) indicating competitive research rather than a bona fide buyer despite the stated budget (model suspected manipulation, not confirmed by rules).

Pre-seed startup with a clear SEO need but current monthly budget $3,000 (below our $15k+ threshold) and plans to scale in ~6 months — add to nurture sequence and follow up around fundraising timeline.

Lead claims a family restaurant group (4 locations) seeking local SEO with a stated budget of $2,500/month—below Single Grain’s typical minimum and missing company/website details, so follow up to qualify timing, ownership, and scope (same contact as L-002).
Local HVAC company seeking more service calls with a stated monthly budget of $6,000, below Single Grain's typical $15k+ threshold — enroll in nurture for follow-up and scaling options.

Healthcare staffing platform with a clear demand-gen need and compliance constraints, in-house marketing team of 3, and a stated monthly budget of $15,000 — sales should call now (budget parsed from text).
Valid company (Quorum Data) provided a $22,000/mo budget but left the message blank so marketing needs and timing are unknown—follow up to qualify needs and timing.
Data-deletion (GDPR/CCPA) request, not a sales lead; route to the privacy owner, who has a legal deadline.
Phishing pattern (payment pressure plus a link to an executable); do not open the link, report to security.
